verdict.rationale: Weave's first-party W&B MCP Server lets AI assistants answer natural-language questions about runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts. Combined with W&B Skills, the docs say coding agents like Claude Code can read production data, run evaluations, and iterate on their own. All of this natural-language operation goes through an external agent client rather than a native in-product interface, and the claims that agents can take actions (beyond answering read-only questions) come mainly from marketing pages. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, detailed documentation of which write or operational actions can be driven by natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
